history.text: The Kingdom of Kongo and later Luba and Lunda states organised the region.
Leopold II of Belgium held the territory as a personal possession, the Congo Free State.
Belgium annexed the colony after international outcry over forced labour.
Independence came on 30 June, with Patrice Lumumba as first prime minister.
Mobutu Sese Seko ruled, renaming the country Zaire.
Two wars drew in neighbouring states and caused vast loss of life.

worthSeeing.title: Virunga National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Africa's oldest national park, with mountain gorillas and the Nyiragongo lava lake.

worthSeeing.title: Congo River:
worthSeeing.text: The river route between Kinshasa and Kisangani, the country's historic artery.

worthSeeing.title: Garamba National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Northern savannah reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
